prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1460; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for a parking lot collision at a retail center. Insured reports a rear-end impact while the vehicle was stopped in a marked space. Claimant vehicle identified as the other party. Initial contact made by phone with the insured to confirm the basic facts and obtain the policy number.

Entry 2: Recorded statement taken from the claimant. Claimant reports neck strain following the impact and says she is not represented by an attorney. Claimant describes stiffness and soreness on the morning after the collision. Advised claimant of the claims process and that she may choose to consult counsel at any time. Medical treatment status not yet confirmed.

Entry 3: Reviewed photos submitted by both parties. Visible bumper damage on both vehicles, consistent with low-speed contact. Parking lot surveillance footage requested from the property manager. Scene diagram received from the insured showing the position of both vehicles at impact.

Entry 4: Claimant provided a medical note from her treating provider documenting a cervical strain with a recommended course of physical therapy. Note reviewed. Claimant indicated she is managing her own correspondence and has not retained representation. Requested signed authorization to obtain treatment records.

Entry 5: Property manager confirmed the surveillance footage was overwritten after the standard retention period, so no video is available. Liability review underway based on statements, photos, and scene diagram. Claimant reminded of the reporting timeline for any additional medical bills. File remains open pending records and repair estimates.
